title: Why I started yoga
instructions: Nina yogaya nasıl başladığını anlatıyor. Sebebe, sıklığa ve sonuca dikkat et.

script.speaker: nina
script.text: Last year, I had a lot of stress at work, and I couldn't sleep well.

script.speaker: nina
script.text: A friend told me to try yoga, so I joined a class near my house.

script.speaker: nina
script.text: Now I go twice a week, on Monday and Thursday evenings.

script.speaker: nina
script.text: It was difficult at first, because I'm not very flexible.

script.speaker: nina
script.text: But now I feel calmer, and I sleep much better.

options: She had stress and couldn't sleep well.
